comment: The module catalogue. scripts/release-manifest.mjs copies it into each release's signed manifest, with every image pinned by digest. Images of services in compose.yml come from compose.yml; a module with its own compose block lists its images under images.

modules.name: Player
modules.purpose: Plays your albums in tagave and serves phone apps, with a bundled Navidrome.
modules.keepsOnRemoval: Navidrome's database (its plays, stars and users) in the player-data volume, the player's library, play counts and Last.fm and ListenBrainz connections in tagave, and its password and key in .env

appData.removes: Deletes Navidrome's database and, in tagave, the player's library, play counts and connected Last.fm and ListenBrainz accounts.
appData.history: Also delete the listens the player recorded. Listens you added yourself stay.
